arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ صَـلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِـهِ وَتَـوَلَّنِي فِي جيرَانِي وَمَوَالِيَّ وَالْعَارِفِينَ بحَقِّنَا وَالْمُنَابِذِينَ لأِعْدَائِنَا بِأَفْضَلِ وَلاَيَتِكَ،
transliteration: allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālih wa tawallani fi jirani wa mawaliyya wal-ʿarifin bihaqqina wal-munabithin li-aʿda'ina bi-afḍalī wilayat
english_text: O God, bless Muhammad and his Household and attend to me with Thy best attending in my neighbours and friends who recognize our right and war against our enemies!

arabic_text: وَوَفِّقْهُمْ لإقَامَةِ سُنَّتِكَ وَالأَخْذِ بِمَحَاسِنِ أَدَبِكَ فِي إرْفَاقِ ضَعِيفِهِمْ، وَسَدِّ خَلَّتِهِمْ، وَعِيَادَةِ مَرِيضِهِمْ، وَهِدَايَةِ مُسْتَرْشِدِهِمْ، وَمُنَاصَحَةِ مُسْتَشِيرِهِمْ،
transliteration: wa waffiqhum li-iqāmati sunnatika wa al-akhḏi bi maḥāsin adabika fī ʾirfāqi ḍaʿīfihim wa saddi khallatihim, wa ʿiyadati mariḍihim wa-hidāyatim mustarshiḍihim, wa-munāṣaḥatim mustashirihim
english_text: Give [my neighbours and friends] success in performing Thy prescriptions and taking on the beauties of Thy courtesy through acting gently with their weak, remedying their lacks, visiting their sick, guiding their seeker of right guidance, giving good counsel to their seeker of advice,

arabic_text: وَتَعَهُّدِ قَادِمِهِمْ، وَكِتْمَانِ أَسْرَارِهِمْ، وَسَتْرِ عَوْرَاتِهِمْ، وَنُصْرَةِ مَظْلُومِهِمْ، وَحُسْنِ مُوَاسَاتِهِمْ بِالْمَاعُونِ، وَالْعَوْدِ عَلَيْهِمْ بِـالْجِـدَةِ وَالإِفْضَـالِ،
transliteration: wa taʿahhud qadimihim, wa kitman asrarihim wa satri ʿawrātihim, wa nuṣrati maẓlūmihim waḥusni muwāsātihim bil-māʿūn wal-ʿawdi ʿalayhim bil-jidati wal-i’fdhāl
english_text: attending to the one among them who returns from travel, hiding their secrets, covering over their shameful things, helping their wronged, sharing kindly with them in goods, turning toward them with wealth and bestowal of bounty,

arabic_text: وَإعْطَآءِ مَـا يَجِبُ لَهُمْ قَبْلَ السُّؤالِ
transliteration: wa-iʿṭāʾi mā yajibu lahum qabla al-suʾāl
english_text: and giving what is due to them before they ask!

arabic_text: واجْعَلْنِي اللَّهُمَّ أَجْزِي بِالإحْسَانِ مُسِيْئَهُمْ، وَاعْرِضُ بِالتَّجَاوُزِ عَنْ ظَالِمِهِمْ،
transliteration: wajʿalni allāhumma ajzi bil-iḥsāni musīʾahum waʿridhu bi-ttajāwuzi ʿan ẓalimihim
english_text: Let me, O God, repay their evildoer with good-doing, turn away from their wrongdoer with forbearance.

arabic_text: وَأَسْتَعْمِلْ حُسْنَ الظّنِّ فِي كَافَّتِهِمْ، وَأَتَوَلَّى بِالْبِرِّ عَامَّتَهُمْ، وَأَغُضُّ بَصَرِي عَنْهُمْ عِفَّةً، وَألِينُ جَانِبِيْ لَهُمْ تَوَاضُعاً، وَأَرِقُّ عَلَى أَهْلِ الْبَلاءِ مِنْهُمْ رَحْمَةً،
transliteration: wa-astʿmil husna al-ẓunni fī kaffatihim, wa-atawallā bilbirri ʿāmmatahum wa-aġuddu baṣarī 'anhum 'iffatan wa'alīnu jānibī lahum tawāḍuʿan wa'ariqqu ʿalaa ahli-l-balaa'i minhum rahmatan
english_text: have a good opinion of every one of them, attend to all of them with devotion, lower my eyes before them in continence, make mild my side toward them in humility, be tender toward the afflicted among them in mercy,

arabic_text: وَأسِرُّ لَهُمْ بِالْغَيْبِ مَوَدَّةً، وَأُحِبُّ بَقَاءَ النِّعْمَةِ عِنْدَهُمْ نُصْحاً، وَاُوجِبُ لَهُمْ مَا اُوجِبُ لِحَامَّتِي، وَأَرْعَى لَهُمْ مَا أَرْعَى لِخَاصَّتِي.
transliteration: wa-asirru lahum bil-ghaybi mawaddatan wa ʾuḥibbu baqāʾa al-niʿmati ʿindahum nuṣḥan wa ujibu lahum ma ujibu lihāmmatī wa-arʿā lahum mā arʿā li-khāṣṣatī
english_text: make them happy in absence through affection, love that they continue to receive favour through good will, grant them what I grant my next of kin, and observe for them what I observe for my special friends!

arabic_text: أَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمِّد وَآلِهِ ، وَارْزُقْنِي مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ مِنْهُمْ، وَاجْعَلْ لِي أَوْفَى الْحُظُوظِ فِيمَا عِنْدَهُمْ ، وَزِدْهُمْ بَصِيْرَةً فِي حَقِّي، وَمَعْرِفَةً بِفَضْلِي،
transliteration: allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā muḥammadin wa ālihī warzuqni mithla dhalika minhum wa ajʿal li awfā al-ḥuẓuẓi fīmā ʿindahum wa zidhum basīratan fī ḥaqqī, wa maʿrifatan bifadlī
english_text: O God, bless Muhammad and his Household, provide me the like of that from them, appoint for me the fullest share of what is with them, increase them in insight toward my right and knowledge of my excellence
so that they will be fortunate through me and I fortunate through them!
